sources.label: alexdev
sources.summary: CS student at State University. I like building tools.

draft.title: study-buddy
lines: Built a flashcard app with SM-2 spaced repetition, enabling scheduled reviews for effective learning.
Implemented the frontend and backend using TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase, and styled with Tailwind CSS.
Maintained the project as a solo contributor with 84 commits and deployed it live at study-buddy.vercel.app.

draft.title: rust-ray
lines: Developed a small ray tracer in Rust based on the Ray Tracing in One Weekend book to gain expertise in graphics programming.
Solely managed the rust-ray repository with 23 commits, demonstrating focused development and ownership.

question.prompt: What did you build in study-buddy?
question.answer: SM-2 review scheduling and the CSV import. About 40 classmates used it before the CS 314 final.
